assertions.title: Landing page renders and adapts to auth state

steps.action: Open / in a clean browser session while signed out.
steps.expected: The landing page renders the hero, capability sections, flow content, footer, and a signed-out primary CTA to /sign-up.
steps.observed: The signed-out landing page rendered the hero copy, capability cards, How It Works content, and a primary CTA labelled 'Sign Up & Start Building' with href /sign-up.

steps.action: Create an authenticated session and revisit /.
steps.expected: The primary CTA changes to 'Open Dashboard' with the signed-in session state resolved.
steps.observed: The signed-in branch never became reachable because both browser-observed auth forms and supplementary curl.exe auth replays failed after the initial 202 response with a missing janus-node-runtime dependency.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed via agent-browser errors on the landing page
evidence.network: Landing CTA href resolved to /sign-up. Supplementary curl.exe replays: POST /api/v1/auth/signup -> 202 then GET /api/v1/operations/op_ca114231569f7548fd398adc -> failed service_unavailable; POST /api/v1/auth/signin/password -> 202 then GET /api/v1/operations/op_5212e364be94168aaf0ff04a -> failed service_unavailable (missing janus-node-runtime dependency).

assertions.issues: Blocked by the backend auth dependency failure, which prevented reaching the signed-in landing state.

assertions.title: Sign-in flow completes successfully

steps.action: Open /sign-in and enter the isolated test email.
steps.expected: Continue enables for a valid email and reveals the password step.
steps.observed: The two-step form worked locally: Continue enabled for the valid email and revealed the password field.

steps.action: Inspect the password-step links.
steps.expected: Forgot your password? navigates to /reset-password?email=... and Email sign-in code navigates to /magic-code?email=....
steps.observed: The browser exposed the expected links, with Forgot your password? resolving to /reset-password?email=frontend-hardening-ut%2Bauth-round2-20260315%40example.com and Email sign-in code resolving to /magic-code?email=frontend-hardening-ut%2Bauth-round2-20260315%40example.com.

steps.action: Submit the password step with the isolated credentials.
steps.expected: Successful sign-in redirects to /get-started, while invalid credentials would surface an inline auth error.
steps.observed: The browser stayed on /sign-in and rendered the inline grain-activation error 'auth grain activate: node runtime dependency "janus-node-runtime" not found in injected dependencies', so the success redirect and a normal invalid-credentials branch were both pre-empted by the backend failure.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed via agent-browser errors during the sign-in flow
evidence.network: Supplementary curl.exe replay: POST /api/v1/auth/signin/password -> 202 then GET /api/v1/operations/op_5212e364be94168aaf0ff04a -> failed service_unavailable with missing janus-node-runtime dependency.

assertions.issues: Blocked because password sign-in never reached its redirect or normal invalid-credentials branch; the auth operation failed during grain activation.

steps.expected: Continue enables and reveals the password step.
steps.observed: The valid email enabled Continue and revealed the password step.

steps.expected: A short password keeps Create account disabled, while a valid password enables submission.

steps.observed: The Sign in link navigated to /sign-in, but the form submission stayed on /sign-up and showed the inline grain-activation failure instead of redirecting.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed via agent-browser errors during the sign-up flow
evidence.network: Supplementary curl.exe replay: POST /api/v1/auth/signup -> 202 then GET /api/v1/operations/op_ca114231569f7548fd398adc -> failed service_unavailable with missing janus-node-runtime dependency.

assertions.issues: Blocked because account creation never completed; the auth signup operation failed during grain activation.

assertions.title: Magic-code (passwordless) flow works end-to-end

steps.action: Open /magic-code?email=<isolated-email>.
steps.expected: The email is prefilled, the request auto-sends, and six OTP inputs appear.
steps.observed: The email was prefilled and the page immediately rendered six OTP inputs plus a disabled Resend now button, even though the underlying request later proved to have failed.

steps.action: Exercise OTP keyboard handling.
steps.expected: Typing advances focus, ArrowLeft moves back, and Backspace navigates between digit inputs correctly.
steps.observed: Typing the first digit moved focus to digit 2, ArrowLeft returned focus to digit 1, and Backspace from the empty second field moved focus back and cleared the first digit.

steps.action: Enter an invalid 6-digit code.
steps.expected: Verification auto-submits, shows an inline invalid-code error, and resets the OTP inputs.
steps.observed: Typing 123456 auto-submitted, showed the inline message 'Invalid one-time code', and cleared the OTP inputs.

steps.action: Attempt to complete the happy path and resend flow.
steps.expected: A valid code redirects to /get-started and Resend now can re-issue a code.
steps.observed: The request prerequisite was broken: a supplementary curl.exe replay showed the magic-code request operation failing with the missing janus-node-runtime dependency, and Resend now never became enabled during the rerun window.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed via agent-browser errors during the magic-code flow
evidence.network: Supplementary curl.exe replay: POST /api/v1/auth/magic-code/request -> 202 then GET /api/v1/operations/op_8b8891116dfb97dd7b40b86d -> failed service_unavailable with missing janus-node-runtime dependency. Browser-side invalid verification still auto-submitted and surfaced 'Invalid one-time code'.

assertions.issues: Blocked because the passwordless request operation failed upstream, preventing any valid-code success path from being completed end-to-end.

assertions.title: Topbar displays correct contextual information

steps.action: Open /get-started while signed out and switch between dashboard views.
steps.expected: The topbar shows the active workspace label, signed-out state, and the no-project hint when no projects exist.
steps.observed: The signed-out shell showed 'Current view: Pipeline', 'Signed out', and 'Create a project in Projects view'; switching to Projects updated the URL to /get-started?view=projects and the topbar label to 'Current view: Projects'.

steps.action: Create an authenticated session so the signed-in email branch can be rechecked.
steps.expected: The topbar updates to the user's email and still reacts correctly after auth state changes.
steps.observed: The authenticated branch never became reachable because both sign-up and sign-in auth operations failed with the missing janus-node-runtime dependency.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed via agent-browser errors on /get-started
evidence.network: Signed-out dashboard view switching was client-side (/get-started?view=pipeline -> /get-started?view=projects). Supplementary curl.exe auth replays for signup/signin both ended in failed service_unavailable operations caused by the missing janus-node-runtime dependency.

assertions.issues: Blocked because only the signed-out branch could be validated; the signed-in email branch could not be reached.

steps.expected: A visible loading indicator appears while project data is in flight.
steps.observed: Within 100 ms the page was already showing the signed-out empty state 'No projects yet.' rather than a stable Loading... indicator.

steps.expected: The button shows Refreshing... while the request is in flight.
steps.observed: The panel surfaced 'unauthorized Sign in first so the janus_access cookie is present.' without any stable Refreshing... capture.

steps.action: Unlock authenticated create/import/upload/deploy/log flows.
steps.expected: Authenticated buttons and the log modal expose Creating... / Importing... / Uploading... / Deploying... / Loading logs... states.
steps.observed: Those richer loading states remained unreachable because the prerequisite signup/signin auth operations failed with the missing janus-node-runtime dependency.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed via agent-browser errors during the loading-state probes
evidence.network: Signed-out dashboard requests fell through to the unauthorized branch, and supplementary curl.exe signup/signin replays both ended in failed service_unavailable operations before any authenticated loading-state path could be exercised.

assertions.issues: Blocked by the auth prerequisite; only fast signed-out empty/unauthorized states were reachable, so the required authenticated loading indicators could not be validated.

steps.action: Create or restore an authenticated dashboard session in the assigned browser session.
steps.expected: A sign-out control becomes visible on the dashboard.
steps.observed: No authenticated session could be established because browser-observed sign-up/sign-in attempts both failed with the missing janus-node-runtime dependency.

steps.expected: Clicking Sign out issues POST /api/v1/auth/signout, clears auth state, and redirects to landing or sign-in.

evidence.network: No POST /api/v1/auth/signout was emitted because no authenticated session or sign-out control ever became available. Supplementary curl.exe signup/signin replays both failed with missing janus-node-runtime dependency errors.

frictions.description: The /magic-code page still rendered OTP inputs and a preview email block even though the underlying auth.magic.request operation had already failed, which made the happy-path surface look available until the operation record was checked separately.
frictions.resolution: Cross-checked the browser flow with a curl.exe replay and the returned /api/v1/operations/op_8b8891116dfb97dd7b40b86d record, which confirmed the request had failed with service_unavailable.

frictions.description: agent-browser's request log reported no captured network traffic during these auth reruns, so the browser alone did not expose the operation IDs needed to explain the blockers.
frictions.resolution: Replayed the same signup, signin, magic-code request, and reset-password request with curl.exe against http://localhost:8080 and polled the returned operation IDs directly.

blockers.description: All exercised auth mutations still fail after their initial 202 response because the auth grain cannot activate without the injected dependency 'janus-node-runtime'.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Retried sign-up, sign-in, magic-code, reset-password, and dashboard-auth prerequisite flows in the assigned browser session, then replayed signup/signin/magic-code request/reset request with curl.exe. Each replay returned 202 and then polled to failed/service_unavailable with the same missing janus-node-runtime dependency message.

summary: Re-ran 8 assigned auth-surface assertions against the source-built frontend on port 3000. All 8 remain blocked by the same backend auth grain dependency failure: signed-out landing/dashboard branches still render, but signup, signin, magic-code request, and reset-password request all fail after the initial 202 response with a missing janus-node-runtime dependency, which also prevents reaching the signed-in landing, signed-in topbar, authenticated loading states, and signout flow.
